messages.content: I want to plan a trip to Paris in March. I prefer boutique hotels over big chains.
Great choice! March is a wonderful time to visit Paris. For boutique hotels, I'd recommend Le Marais or Saint-Germain-des-Prés neighborhoods.
I love French cuisine, especially croissants and cheese. Remember I'm lactose intolerant though.
Noted! I'll keep your lactose intolerance in mind when recommending restaurants. Many Parisian restaurants now offer dairy-free options.
My budget is around $3000 for the whole trip including flights.
I need to finish the API migration by end of Q3. The deadline is September 30.
Let's break this down into milestones. How many endpoints need migration?
About 45 endpoints. I want to prioritize the payment and auth services first.
